title: SG90 micro servo mount
prompt: Mounting plate for an SG90 micro servo: 40 x 20 x 3 mm with a 23 x 12.5 mm rectangular cutout in the middle for the servo body, and two 2.2 mm holes for the servo's mounting screws, 27.5 mm apart along the long axis (centred).

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
Three cut-outs: the servo opening and two screw holes
Two 2.2 mm screw holes (2.1–2.4 mm) 27.5 mm apart
Ten flat faces: four outside, four cut-out walls, top and bottom

notes: Dimensions as given by the user (SG90 body ~22.5 x 12 mm, tab holes ~27.5 mm apart).
